title: Cycle deletion: the edge count of the remaining tree

located_defect.lean_text:
def SourceSentence (k : ℕ) : Prop := SentenceWith k ((k : ℤ) - 1)
def UniversalSourceSentence : Prop := ∀ k : ℕ, SourceSentence k
located_defect.description: After deleting m cycle edges from a connected graph G on k + 1 vertices, the source asserts (stored source line 0012) that the remaining tree G' has k - 1 edges and G has k - 1 + m edges. Stated through the template SentenceWith k c with c the printed count of G', this is the located defect. Supply the corrected count c(k), prove the corrected sentence for every k ≥ 2, and prove the theorem the source set out to prove, SourceTheorem.

-/
namespace Census_SE_math_1291495__q

-- ===== FIXED PART: only the hole «HOLE» may be edited =====
/-- The corrected edge count of the spanning tree `G'` on `k + 1` vertices, as an integer expression in
`k` (the source prints `k - 1`). Only this count may be changed; by the template `SentenceWith` the
companion count of `G` is `edge_count k + m`. The hole must be a closed expression in `k`. -/
def edge_count (k : ℕ) : ℤ := «HOLE»

/-- The corrected sentence for every `k ≥ 2`, the range on which the source's hypotheses can be met
(shape fixed). -/
def CorrectedSentence : Prop := ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → SentenceWith k (edge_count k)
-- ===== END FIXED PART =====

end Census_SE_math_1291495__q
